rv.q: The standout is Champlin, whose Cheryl-Ann possesses the guilelessness and frolicsome nature of a Labrador puppy.
In Erica Murray's tender and touching drama The Loved Ones at Irish Rep, Plunkett is playing the bundled-up, buttoned-up Nell.
The Loved Ones is unusually charming.
The Loved Ones stands on more secure ground when the focus remains on Nell.

cn.t: Murray's intimate Irish drama charms with wit and warmth as four women navigate grief and secrets at a remote farmhouse, anchored by Maryann Plunkett's grounded performance in an engaging if familiar women's story.
